data.body: Token proof 2026-11-18 12:35 PST: read HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN's SSM copy (/rebar/prod/homebrew-tap-token) into a shell variable only (not printed or written; unset after), read the tap workflow state with it (`active`), and dispatched `gh workflow run autobump.yml --repo navapbc/homebrew-rebar --ref main`. Run 44392705016: event workflow_dispatch, conclusion success, log `current=0.16.0 latest=0.16.0 / already current — no-op`. Formula/rebar.rb points at nava_rebar-0.16.0.tar.gz, matching PyPI 0.16.0. Portability: the change is a GitHub Actions job on ubuntu-latest plus a YAML structure test (yaml.safe_load + string checks); no subprocesses, fds, paths, encodings or permissions in rebar code, so no Windows sweep dispatch is needed.
